callerHistory: 180-second observed exit after a five-second quote delay; 10% proceeds haircut; frozen before each UTC day

search.description: Retrospective daily training selection. Dates were previously examined; this is not a new holdout.
search.screen: Training clipped-return mean minus one standard error is a ranking heuristic, not a confidence interval.

robustSelection.selection: At least eight prior trades and contracts, positive 10% haircut account return after either two-best-token or best-day removal, at most 3% training drawdown bound; rank by the lowest return after removals minus one-quarter of drawdown.

scope: Retrospective human-authored calls only. Prior research examined these dates; no independent profitability claim.
publicationRedaction: Caller identities and message identifiers removed from public results.
